items.raw_excerpt: Residents of Piddington, near Bicester, will vote in a symbolic referendum on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: A small village called Piddington, near Bicester in England, will hold a symbolic referendum on Tuesday. The residents will vote on whether the village should leave the UK. The vote is symbolic, so it will not change anything for real.
items.summary_ko: 영국 비체스터 근처의 작은 마을 피딩턴이 화요일에 상징적인 주민투표를 열 예정이다. 주민들은 마을이 영국에서 떠날지 여부를 놓고 투표하게 된다. 이 투표는 상징적인 것이라 실제로 달라지는 것은 없다.
items.title_en: Why is a village holding a referendum on leaving the UK?
items.title_ko: 가는 마을이 왜 영국 탈퇴 주민투표를 여나?
items.title_original: Why is a village holding a referendum on leaving the UK?

items.raw_excerpt: With France experiencing hotter summers and more heatwaves, interest is growing in the coolest areas of the country to either move to or stay in over the summer - and now a group of experts have listed seven 'cool refuges'.
items.summary_en: France is having hotter summers and more heatwaves. People want to find the coolest parts of the country to move to or stay in. Experts have listed seven 'cool refuges' across France.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스의 여름이 더 뜨거워지고 폭염이 잦아지면서, 더 시원한 지역으로 이주하거나 여름을 보내려는 관심이 커지고 있습니다. 전문가들이 프랑스 전역에서 일곱 곳의 ‘시원한 피난처’를 선정했습니다.
items.title_en: France's 7 'cool refuges' as summers heat up

items.summary_en: A Polish ice cream company started a campaign against rude and inappropriate comments from customers. The campaign plays on the Polish word "lody", which means ice cream but also has a rude meaning. Staff may now refuse to serve customers who harass them.
items.summary_ko: 폴란드 아이스크림 회사가 손님들의 무례하고 부적절한 농담을 막기 위한 캠페인을 시작했다. 이 캠페인은 아이스크림을 뜻하는 폴란드어 'lody'가 다른 뜻으로도 쓰이는 점을 활용한다. 괴롭히는 손님에게는 점원들이 판매를 거부할 수 있다.
items.title_en: Polish ice cream chain starts campaign against creepy customers
items.title_ko: 폴란드 아이스크림 체인, 손님 성희롱 막는 캠페인 시작
items.title_original: “Don’t be a creep”: Polish ice cream company launches campaign against sexual harassment of staff

items.raw_excerpt: How Italians describe something so boring it tests your patience.
items.summary_en: Italians have a funny expression that means something is so boring it tests your patience. 'Far venire il latte alle ginocchia' literally means making milk come to your knees. It describes a very boring situation that is hard to sit through.

items.raw_excerpt: Hyderabad's Ganesh Chaturthi features towering and diamond-studded idols, showcasing a 72-foot Ganesha and diamond-studded creations.
items.summary_en: For Ganesh Chaturthi, Hyderabad is showing off very large Ganesha statues. One statue is 72 feet tall, and others are decorated with diamonds. Local people say this year's idols are bigger and brighter than before.

items.summary_en: Spanish paleontologists found the first evidence that Diplodocus once roamed Europe. The fossils were found in Teruel in eastern Spain. The research was published in the Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology.

items.raw_excerpt: A tender for flights serving Þórshöfn and Vopnafjörður remains unresolved. State support averaged about ISK 107,000 per passenger in 2024.
items.summary_en: A contract for flights to the towns of Þórshöfn and Vopnafjörður is still not decided. In 2024, the government spent about 107,000 Icelandic kronur per passenger on these routes. Local leaders say the uncertainty is a problem.

items.title_original: Northeast Iceland Leaders Criticise Uncertainty Over State-Supported Flights

items.raw_excerpt: A survey by the Portuguese Association of Publishers and Booksellers (APEL) reveals that fewer than two-thirds of participants say they read for leisure in their free time, far behind social media use.
items.summary_en: A survey by the Portuguese Association of Publishers and Booksellers found that fewer than two-thirds of participants read for leisure in their free time. Social media use far exceeds reading time among Portuguese people.

items.raw_excerpt: Have you ever heard of this Danish word before?
items.summary_en: Today's Danish word is 'uhørt'. It means 'unheard of' or 'outrageous'. Danes use it when something is shocking or unacceptable.

items.title_en: Danish word of the day: Uhørt

items.raw_excerpt: Lydia Leija dispels common myths and misconceptions around El Grito de Independencia, an integral part of Mexican Independence celebrations.
items.summary_en: An article clears up common myths about El Grito de Independencia, Mexico's biggest Independence Day celebration. It explains that the holiday marks the start of the war in 1810, not the end. It also looks at why the party happens on September 15 and what Miguel Hidalgo really shouted.
items.summary_ko: 이 글은 멕시코 최대 축제인 독립절 엘 그리토에 대한 흔한 오해를 풀어낸다. 실제로 이 날은 1810년 독립 전쟁의 시작을 기념하는 날이지 전쟁이 끝난 날이 아니라고 설명한다. 왜 축제가 9월 15일에 열리는지, 미겔 이달고가 실제로 외친 말이 무엇인지도 살펴본다.
items.title_en: El Grito de Independencia: Common myths and misconceptions

items.raw_excerpt: Even if the job description doesn't say you need to speak Danish, some employers are reluctant to employ people who don't speak a word of the language. But not all! Here are the jobs you can get in Denmark without knowing any more than 'tak' and 'goddag'.
items.summary_en: Some employers in Denmark will not hire people who do not speak Danish, even if the job listing says language is not required. But some other employers welcome such workers. This article explains what jobs you can get when you only know greeting words like tak and goddag.

items.raw_excerpt: Antarctic krill serve as a crucial food source for penguins, seals, and whales. They recycle nutrients used by algae. Now researchers say they've found krill in a surprising place: hydrothermal vents.
items.summary_en: Antarctic krill are a key food for penguins, seals, and whales. They also recycle nutrients used by algae. Now researchers found krill inside deep-sea hydrothermal vents. Scientists want to know why they go there.
